;Disasters and accidents
*[[August 2018 Lombok earthquake]]
**The BNPB spokesperson Sutopo Purwo Nugroho confirmed that the death toll from the earthquake in [[Lombok]] rises to 436. [https://en.tempo.co/read/news/2018/08/13/055920764/Lombok-Quake-Death-Toll-Reaches-392-Lives (Tempo.co)]
*A report by the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights|SOHR]] says that the explosion of an arms depot in [[Sarmada]], [[Idlib Governorate]], [[Syria]], kills at least 69 people, including 17 children. The cause of the blast is "not yet clear". Most of the victims were reportedly family members of [[Hayat Tahrir al-Sham]] militants. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-toll/death-toll-in-syria-blast-climbs-to-69-observatory-idUSKBN1KY0VT (Reuters)]
*At least 15 people die after a bus falls into a ravine in the western region of [[Ancash]], in [[Peru]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-08/13/c_137385758.htm (Xinhua)]

;International relations
*[[Convention on the legal status of the Caspian Sea]]
**After more than 20 years of negotiations, the five countries bordering the [[Caspian Sea]] sign an agreement in [[Aktau]], [[Kazakhstan]], on its shared use and the distribution of its resources. The convention legally defines the body of water as a [[sea]] rather than a [[lake]], but with special provisions. [https://www.dw.com/en/russia-iran-and-other-states-agree-on-caspian-sea-access/a-45051799 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Foreign relations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]], [[Foreign relations of South Africa]]
**[[President of South Africa|South African President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] meets with [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|President]] [[Joseph Kabila]] of [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|DR Congo]] in [[Kinshasa]], praising him for his "respect for the [[Constitution of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|constitution]]" by agreeing to step down and not take part in the upcoming [[Democratic Republic of the Congo general election, 2018|December 2018 Congolese general election]]. [https://www.thesouthafrican.com/ramaphosa-praises-kabilas-respect-for-dr-congo-constitution/ (''The South African'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Moss Side mass shooting]]
**Ten people are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Manchester]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-45160462 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Unite the Right 2]]
**Around twenty white nationalists hold a protest march in [[Washington, D.C.]] on the first anniversary of the [[Unite the Right rally]], with thousands of counter-protesters. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/charlottesville-year-later-washington-1.4782450 (AP via CBC News)]

;Science and technology
